integrity.proof_type: analytic branchwise curvature proof with exact algebra checks
integrity.verification: symbolic identities, exact rational witness, deterministic spot checks

scientific_limitations: Exact curvature classification holds for a single unit-scale logistic coordinate or coordinate-separable weighted sums, not arbitrary correlated-feature logistic regression.
The stationary-point equivalence is asserted for 0 < gamma < 4, not for arbitrary large stepsizes.
Numerical checks are finite illustrations; the complete real-line proof uses branch inequalities and explicit strict witnesses.
Historical-priority searches cannot certify the absence of all equivalent publications.
title: Sharp global convexity restoration in sparse logistic forward–backward envelopes
